parsed.summary: The file formally states that, for 0<δ<1/2, the binary rate R₂(δ) = limsup (1/n)·log₂ A(n,⌈δn⌉) satisfies four bounds: it is strictly below the first MRRW bound M₁(δ)=H₂(1/2−√(δ(1−δ))); it is at most κ_bin(δ)=min(κ_H,κ_CW); κ_bin(δ) is strictly below the second MRRW bound M₂(δ); and R₂(δ) < M₂(δ). It also states ε-gap versions, one of which is only claimed for δ<1/3. The main caveat is that the auxiliary definitions cannot be checked against the excerpt: the coordinates z, m, ζ, ξ, the ranges (4)–(5), the Hamming problem (2)–(3) and M₂ are not shown in it. In addition, `strict_mrrw2` taken alone would hold vacuously if a variational feasible set were empty, because then sInf ∅ = 0.
